title: Very stiff beam pinned on a weak rotational spring: small rotation

source.work: ANSYS, Inc., Mechanical APDL Verification Manual (public help site ansyshelp.ansys.com)
source.location: VM41, 'Small Deflection of a Rigid Beam' (https://ansyshelp.ansys.com/public/Views/Secured/corp/v252/en/ans_vm/Hlp_V_VM41.html)
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text; the sketch was not readable). The page cites: 'any basic statics and strength of material book' (the page names no specific reference) - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'Target' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Beam AB of 10 in; A is held against translation and restrained against rotation by a spring of 10,000 in lb/rad; lateral load of 10 lb at B. 'Thick beam' data of the page's modelling notes: A = 100 in^2, I = 1000 in^4, E = 30e6 psi (the beam is very stiff, not rigid: its bending adds 1.1e-7 in at B). First-order analysis. Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
